escena: SCENE: a real digital creative review inside an ambitious contemporary studio at night. Three REAL physical screens at different depths, all entirely visible and facing camera: a large calibrated wall display with a striking abstract cobalt-blue ribbon shape crossing an warm ivory field with a subtle lime-green focal mark; a vertical phone held by a hand in the middle ground showing a CROP and motion-like continuation of that SAME distinctive cobalt ribbon on a deep warm background; a laptop in the right middle ground showing a web hero using the same authored visual grammar in a radically different layout. No logos, no writing, no user interface, no fake holograms. One art director at the far right edge, seen in profile from behind, is comparing the three outcomes, hand poised to adjust the phone. The design is the subject, the person performs a specific decision. Real screen reflections on dark brushed metal and warm concrete; restrained lime-green light comes from the artwork itself, not decoration. A deep cobalt anodized aluminum frame carries blue structurally. 50mm lens, eye-level, shallow enough for depth but every screen composition reads as one family. Avoid printed matter, coffee, floating cards and stock-agency meetings. THE EXACT MOMENT: the art director lifts the phone to align its abstract ribbon against the two larger applications, judging whether the visual language survives without a wordmark.

lecho.objeto: the matte-black near edge of the art director’s real review desk on the camera side
lecho.tono: DARK near black, textured anodized metal

texto.muro: a continuous area of charcoal acoustic fabric wall above the entire scene, in deep warm shadow with subtle visible woven texture
